protocol.timeline: Reuse Jan 2021–Dec 2026 from the unchanged 72-month generator. No earlier-period extension is necessary. Do not relabel simulation as recovered original historical availability.
protocol.windowAnchor: Latest selected released month/wave, or latest opening cohort due for 90-day plus declared reporting-lag completion. Anchor never moves backward to skip masked rows. Lookback counts calendar support ending at that anchor, not an equal count of nonmissing observations. Retain actual training start/end and target lead.

turnover.fit: Same nonnegative OLS count estimator, fitted to all L complete months; recent-3 and seasonal-naive stay fixed-window controls. The 12-month trial explicitly relaxes only the offline current 24-month support minimum; every month and seasonal comparator must still be available. Current reference retains 24-month support and 12-month OLS fit.

hiring.fit: Reuse unchanged fixed-penalty aggregate model over positive-exposure cohorts within L calendar months. Preserve zero cohorts in support and at least 24 positive cohorts. Thus 12 and likely 24 calendar months abstain. All-opening denominators and complete 90-day reporting remain required; no completed-case filtering. Current reference uses 36 calendar months.

satisfaction.fit: L/3 consecutive quarterly waves; retain native minimum eight complete comparable waves. The 12-month trial abstains. Same bounded equal-wave OLS over all supported waves; last-wave and recent-3 stay fixed-window controls. Longer history encountering old missing/suppressed waves abstains rather than dropping or imputing them. Current reference uses eight waves.

protocol.selection: None. Freeze protocol and implementation before new-seed generation. Report all windows, methods, failures and current references; no optimization, winner selection or automatic promotion. Current-reference equality at matching settings is a mechanics check on original seed 17 before evaluation.
protocol.comparison: Same test seed/family/origin/targets for every window. Primary paired comparisons are each supported window minus the current reference, with per-history MAE differences and wins/ties/losses on their scored intersection. Also report all pairwise window comparisons, denominators and abstention reasons. Report family-wise mean history MAE/RMSE, not pooled RMSE; hiring uses existing opening-weighted metrics. No significance claim or calibrated interval.
protocol.controls: Stationary turnover contains stable seasonality and changing stock; this is not a zero-signal count process. Stationary hiring and satisfaction have no expected trend. Gradual improvement supplies drift, reversal begins after origin without a model warning, and reporting stress supplies delays/revisions. Native November 2025 partial-support replay adds missingness guards. Survey instrument breaks block future-label scoring. No new planted mechanisms or model inputs.
protocol.reserve: October–December target periods/cohorts are not scored. July–September hiring follow-up overlaps later calendar dates.

units.hiring: opening-weighted percentage-point MAE plus Brier/log loss

aggregation: Mean per-history metrics; mean history RMSE is not pooled RMSE. Pairwise contrasts use common scored histories only; absence of support is not an error value.
limitations: New simulated seeds, not reconstructed source history or real-world validation.
Current methods and app contracts are unchanged; 12-month turnover uses an explicitly exploratory support exception.
No pure seasonality-off turnover control: stable hazard includes seasonal variation and changing headcount.
Hiring gradual improvement changes duration but generally not the within-90-day target probability.
Old missing survey waves prevent a clean 60-month accuracy comparison; short unsupported arms are eligibility results only.
One held-out quarter under each known generating family is not a general learning curve.
